Narratif généré : StructureMap CdaPatientSummaryToBundle

map "https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaPatientSummaryToBundle" = "CdaPatientSummaryToBundle"

// Mapping CDA Patient Summary vers FHIR - Étape 4 finale

uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/ClinicalDocument|2.0.0-sd" alias ClinicalDocument as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/PatientRole|2.0.0-sd" alias PatientRole as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/RelatedEntity|2.0.0-sd" alias RelatedEntity as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/EncompassingEncounter|2.0.0-sd" alias EncompassingEncounter as source
uses "http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/HealthCareFacility|2.0.0-sd" alias HealthCareFacility as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle|4.0.1" alias Bundle as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Composition|4.0.1" alias Composition as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient|4.0.1" alias Patient as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Organization|4.0.1" alias Organization as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Practitioner|4.0.1" alias Practitioner as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/PractitionerRole|4.0.1" alias PractitionerRole as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RelatedPerson|4.0.1" alias RelatedPerson as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Encounter|4.0.1" alias Encounter as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Location|4.0.1" alias Location as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Condition|4.0.1" alias Condition as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/AllergyIntolerance|4.0.1" alias AllergyIntolerance as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/AdverseEvent|4.0.1" alias AdverseEvent as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Medication|4.0.1" alias Medication as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/MedicationStatement|4.0.1" alias MedicationStatement as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Procedure|4.0.1" alias Procedure as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Immunization|4.0.1" alias Immunization as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation|4.0.1" alias Observation as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CarePlan|4.0.1" alias CarePlan as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DocumentReference|4.0.1" alias DocumentReference as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport|4.0.1" alias DiagnosticReport as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/MedicationRequest|4.0.1" alias MedicationRequest as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ServiceRequest|4.0.1" alias ServiceRequest as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ImmunizationRecommendation|4.0.1" alias ImmunizationRecommendation as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/FamilyMemberHistory|4.0.1" alias FamilyMemberHistory as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Identifier|4.0.1" alias Identifier as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CodeableConcept|4.0.1" alias CodeableConcept as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Coding|4.0.1" alias Coding as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Reference|4.0.1" alias Reference as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Period|4.0.1" alias Period as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Attachment|4.0.1" alias Attachment as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Narrative|4.0.1" alias Narrative as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Timing|4.0.1" alias Timing as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Range|4.0.1" alias Range as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Quantity|4.0.1" alias Quantity as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Ratio|4.0.1" alias Ratio as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Annotation|4.0.1" alias Annotation as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/code|4.0.1" alias code as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/date|4.0.1" alias date as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/dateTime|4.0.1" alias dateTime as target
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/boolean|4.0.1" alias boolean as target

imports "https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes|0.1.0"
imports "https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToBundle"
imports "https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaFrToBundle|0.1.0"

// GROUPE D’ENTRÉE — CRÉATION DU BUNDLE FINAL PATIENT SUMMARY

//    Ce groupe crée le Bundle final avec Composition et Patient. Ces ressources
//    sont toujours nécessaires dans un document FHIR de type document.

//    Les autres ressources administratives sont créées plus loin, uniquement si le
//    bloc CDA correspondant existe
group TransformPatientSummaryClinicalDocumentToFHIRDocument(source cda : ClinicalDocument, target bundle : Bundle) {
  cda ->  bundle.entry as compositionEntry,  compositionEntry.resource = create('Composition') as composition,  composition.id = uuid(),  compositionEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %composition.id),  bundle.entry as patientEntry,  patientEntry.resource = create('Patient') as patient,  patient.id = uuid(),  patientEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) then OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation(cda, patient, composition, bundle) "main";
}

// GROUPE D’ORCHESTRATION FINALE — SOCLE FRANÇAIS + MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY
//    Ce groupe applique deux traitements successifs :
//    - MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules, importé depuis l’étape 3, traite
//      l’en-tête CDA, crée les ressources administratives nécessaires, applique le
//      socle générique de l’étape 2 et l’enrichissement français ;
//    - MapPatientSummaryBody traite ensuite les sections Patient Summary et crée
//      les ressources métier à partir des entries CDA.

//    Les ressources optionnelles ne sont donc pas créées au début : elles sont
//    créées uniquement dans les groupes associés aux blocs CDA présents
group OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFinalTransformation(source cda : ClinicalDocument, target patient : Patient, target composition : Composition, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // CDA ClinicalDocument.header -> socle générique + enrichissement français + création interne des ressources administratives
  cda then MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules(cda, bundle, composition, patient) "headerFrenchBase";
  // CDA structuredBody Patient Summary -> FHIR Composition.section + entries métier
  cda then MapPatientSummaryBody(cda, composition, bundle, patient) "patientSummaryBody";
}

// CORPS PATIENT SUMMARY — SECTIONS + ENTRIES MÉTIER
//    Pour chaque section CDA :
//    - MapCDASectionToCompositionSection, importé depuis l’étape 2, crée le
//      squelette commun de la Composition.section avec title, code et text ;
//    - MapPatientSummarySectionEntries crée ensuite les ressources métier selon
//      le code LOINC de la section
group MapPatientSummaryBody(source src : ClinicalDocument, target composition : Composition, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  src.component as cdaComponent then {
    cdaComponent.structuredBody as structuredBody then {
      structuredBody.component as bodyComponent then {
        bodyComponent.section as section -> composition.section as compSection then {
          // CDA section.title/code/text -> FHIR Composition.section
          section then MapCDASectionToCompositionSection(section, compSection) "sectionBase";
          // CDA section.entry -> FHIR ressources métier Patient Summary
          section then MapPatientSummarySectionEntries(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "patientSummaryEntries";
        };
      } "bodyComponent";
    };
  };
}

// DISPATCH DES ENTRIES MÉTIER PATIENT SUMMARY
//    CDA section.code LOINC -> groupe métier FHIR correspondant
group MapPatientSummarySectionEntries(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // CDA section Problèmes actifs -> FHIR Condition
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '11450-4' then PatientSummaryConditionSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "activeProblems";
  // CDA section Antécédents médicaux -> FHIR Condition
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '11348-0' then PatientSummaryConditionSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "medicalHistory";
  // CDA section Allergies / hypersensibilités -> FHIR AllergyIntolerance
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '48765-2' then PatientSummaryAllergySection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "allergies";
  // CDA section Traitements -> FHIR MedicationStatement
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '10160-0' then PatientSummaryMedicationSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "medications";
  // CDA section Historique des actes -> FHIR Procedure
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '47519-4' then PatientSummaryProcedureSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "procedureHistory";
  // Effets indésirables médicamenteux -> AdverseEvent + MedicationStatement + Condition.
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '44939-7' then PatientSummaryAdverseDrugReactionSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "adverseDrugReactions";
  // CDA section Vaccinations -> FHIR Immunization
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '11369-6' then PatientSummaryImmunizationSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "immunizations";
  // CDA section Statut fonctionnel -> FHIR Observation
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '47420-5' then PatientSummaryFunctionalStatusSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "functionalStatus";
  // CDA section Constantes -> FHIR Observation
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '8716-3' then PatientSummaryVitalSignsSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "vitalSigns";
  // CDA section Mode de vie -> FHIR Observation
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '29762-2' then PatientSummaryLifestyleSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "lifestyle";
  // Facteurs de risques professionnels -> Observation si entrée structurée, sinon narratif seul.
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '10161-8' then PatientSummaryProfessionalRisksSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "professionalRisks";
  // CDA section Résultats -> FHIR Observation
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '30954-2' then PatientSummaryResultsSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "results";
  // CDA section Plan de soins -> FHIR CarePlan
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '18776-5' then PatientSummaryCarePlanSection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "carePlan";
  // CDA section Antécédents familiaux -> FHIR FamilyMemberHistory
  section.code as secCode where secCode.code = '10157-6' then PatientSummaryFamilyHistorySection(section, compSection, bundle, patient) "familyHistory";
// Dispositifs médicaux : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.
// Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Device / DeviceUseStatement.
// Points de vigilance : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.
// Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Flag, DetectedIssue ou Observation selon le contenu.
// Directives anticipées : section conservée en narratif uniquement pour l’instant.
// Le mapping structuré sera traité plus tard avec Consent, Observation ou DocumentReference selon le contenu.
}

// 1. PROBLÈMES ACTIFS ET ANTÉCÉDENTS MÉDICAUX
// Section CDA problèmes / antécédents -> Conditions FHIR
group PatientSummaryConditionSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Entrées CDA -> observations de problèmes -> Condition.
  section.entry as entry then {
    entry.act as problemConcernAct then {
      problemConcernAct.entryRelationship as er then {
        er.observation as problemObservation ->  bundle.entry as conditionEntry,  conditionEntry.resource = create('Condition') as condition,  condition.id = uuid(),  conditionEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %condition.id) then PatientSummaryConditionFromProblemObservation(problemObservation, condition, compSection, patient, bundle) "conditionFromProblemObservation";
      } "problemEntryRelationship";
    } "problemConcernAct";
  } "sectionEntry";
}

// Observation CDA de problème -> Condition FHIR
group PatientSummaryConditionFromProblemObservation(source observation, target condition : Condition, target compSection, target patient : Patient, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // Patient concerné.
  observation ->  condition.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Identifiant du problème.
  observation.id as problemId -> condition.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(problemId, identifier) "identifier";
  // Catégorie / type du problème.
  observation.code as problemType -> condition.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then {
    problemType then CDCodeableConcept(problemType, category) "categoryCoding";
    observation.text as txt then {
      txt.reference as ref then {
        ref.value as value -> category.text = cast(value, 'string') "categoryText";
      };
    };
  } "category";
  // Problème médical.
  observation.value as problemValue -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then CDCodeableConcept(problemValue, code) "code";
  // Dates de début et de fin.
  observation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.low as low -> condition.onset = create('dateTime') as onsetDateTime then TSDateTime(low, onsetDateTime) "onsetDateTime";
    effectiveTime.high as high -> condition.abatement = create('dateTime') as abatementDateTime then TSDateTime(high, abatementDateTime) "abatementDateTime";
  };
  // Sous-observations : sévérité, statut, stade et certitude.
  observation.entryRelationship as er then {
    // Sévérité -> Condition.severity.
    er.observation as severityObs then {
      severityObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.29' then {
          severityObs.value as severityValue -> condition.severity = create('CodeableConcept') as severity then CDCodeableConcept(severityValue, severity) "severity";
        } "severity";
      } "severityTemplate";
    } "severityBlock";
    // Statut du problème -> Condition.clinicalStatus.
    er.observation as problemStatusObs then {
      problemStatusObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.30' then {
          problemStatusObs.value as statusValue -> condition.clinicalStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as clinicalStatus then {
            statusValue.displayName as display -> clinicalStatus.text = cast(display, 'string') "clinicalStatusText";
            statusValue.code as code -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical' "clinicalStatusSystem";
              code -> coding.code = cast(code, 'code') "clinicalStatusCode";
              code where code = 'active' -> coding.display = 'Active' "clinicalStatusDisplayActive";
              code where code = 'recurrence' -> coding.display = 'Recurrence' "clinicalStatusDisplayRecurrence";
              code where code = 'relapse' -> coding.display = 'Relapse' "clinicalStatusDisplayRelapse";
              code where code = 'inactive' -> coding.display = 'Inactive' "clinicalStatusDisplayInactive";
              code where code = 'remission' -> coding.display = 'Remission' "clinicalStatusDisplayRemission";
              code where code = 'resolved' -> coding.display = 'Resolved' "clinicalStatusDisplayResolved";
            } "clinicalStatusCoding";
          } "clinicalStatus";
        } "clinicalStatus";
      } "clinicalStatusTemplate";
    } "clinicalStatusBlock";
    // État / stade clinique -> Condition.stage.summary.
    er.observation as healthStatusObs then {
      healthStatusObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.31' then {
          healthStatusObs.value as healthStatusValue -> condition.stage as stage then {
            healthStatusValue -> stage.summary = create('CodeableConcept') as summary then CDCodeableConcept(healthStatusValue, summary) "stageSummary";
          } "stage";
        } "stageSummary";
      } "stageSummaryTemplate";
    } "stageSummaryBlock";
    // Certitude -> Condition.verificationStatus.
    er.observation as certaintyObs then {
      certaintyObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.171' then {
          certaintyObs.value as certaintyValue -> condition.verificationStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as verificationStatus then {
            certaintyValue.displayName as display -> verificationStatus.text = cast(display, 'string') "verificationStatusText";
            certaintyValue.code as code -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' "verificationStatusSystem";
              code -> coding.code = cast(code, 'code') "verificationStatusCode";
              code where code = 'unconfirmed' -> coding.display = 'Unconfirmed' "verificationStatusDisplayUnconfirmed";
              code where code = 'provisional' -> coding.display = 'Provisional' "verificationStatusDisplayProvisional";
              code where code = 'differential' -> coding.display = 'Differential' "verificationStatusDisplayDifferential";
              code where code = 'confirmed' -> coding.display = 'Confirmed' "verificationStatusDisplayConfirmed";
              code where code = 'refuted' -> coding.display = 'Refuted' "verificationStatusDisplayRefuted";
              code where code = 'entered-in-error' -> coding.display = 'Entered in Error' "verificationStatusDisplayEnteredInError";
            } "verificationStatusCoding";
          } "verificationStatus";
        } "verificationStatus";
      } "verificationStatusTemplate";
    } "verificationStatusBlock";
  } "entryRelationships";
  // Document externe lié au problème -> DocumentReference + evidence.
  observation.reference as cdaReference then {
    cdaReference.externalDocument as externalDocument ->  bundle.entry as documentReferenceEntry,  documentReferenceEntry.resource = create('DocumentReference') as documentReference,  documentReference.id = uuid(),  documentReferenceEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %documentReference.id) then {
      externalDocument -> documentReference.status = 'current' "documentReferenceStatus";
      externalDocument ->  documentReference.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "documentReferenceSubject";
      externalDocument.id as externalId -> documentReference.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(externalId, identifier) "documentReferenceIdentifier";
      externalDocument.text as externalText then {
        externalText.reference as externalRef then {
          externalRef.value as url -> documentReference.content as content then {
            url -> content.attachment = create('Attachment') as attachment then {
              url -> attachment.url = cast(url, 'string') "attachmentUrl";
            } "attachment";
          } "content";
        } "externalTextReference";
      } "externalText";
      externalDocument -> condition.evidence as evidence then {
        externalDocument ->  evidence.detail = create('Reference') as detailRef,  detailRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %documentReference.id) "evidenceDetail";
      } "evidence";
    } "externalDocumentReference";
  } "externalReference";
  // Référence de la Condition dans la Composition.section.
  observation ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %condition.id) "sectionEntry";
}

// 2. ALLERGIES / HYPERSENSIBILITÉS
// Section CDA allergies / hypersensibilités -> AllergyIntolerance
group PatientSummaryAllergySection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Section allergies.
  section.templateId as sectionTid then {
    sectionTid.root as sectionRoot where sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.137' then {
      section.entry as entry then {
        entry.act as allergyConcernAct then {
          allergyConcernAct.templateId as actTid then {
            actTid.root as actRoot where actRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.40' then {
              allergyConcernAct.entryRelationship as er then {
                er.observation as allergyObservation then {
                  allergyObservation.templateId as obsTid then {
                    obsTid.root as obsRoot where obsRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.41' ->  bundle.entry as allergyEntry,  allergyEntry.resource = create('AllergyIntolerance') as allergy,  allergy.id = uuid(),  allergyEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %allergy.id) then AllergyFromCdaObservation(allergyObservation, allergy, compSection, patient) "allergyFromCdaObservation";
                  } "allergyObservationTemplate";
                } "allergyObservation";
              } "allergyEntryRelationship";
            } "frAllergyConcernAct";
          } "allergyConcernActTemplate";
        } "allergyConcernAct";
      } "sectionEntry";
    } "frAllergySection";
  } "sectionTemplate";
}

// Observation CDA d’allergie -> AllergyIntolerance
group AllergyFromCdaObservation(source observation, target allergy : AllergyIntolerance, target compSection, target patient : Patient) {
  // Identifiant et patient.
  observation.id as allergyId -> allergy.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(allergyId, identifier) "identifier";
  observation ->  allergy.patient = create('Reference') as patientRef,  patientRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "patient";
  // Agent responsable.
  observation.participant as participant then {
    participant.participantRole as participantRole then {
      participantRole.playingEntity as playingEntity then {
        playingEntity.code as allergenCode -> allergy.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then CDCodeableConcept(allergenCode, code) "allergenCode";
      };
    };
  };
  // Type et catégorie.
  observation.code as allergyTypeCode then {
    allergyTypeCode.code as code where code = '416098002' ->  allergy.type = 'allergy',  allergy.category = 'medication' "medicationAllergyByCode";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where display.lower().contains('intolérance') or display.lower().contains('intolerance') -> allergy.type = 'intolerance' "typeIntolerance";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where (allergyTypeCode.code != '416098002') and (display.lower().contains('allergie') or display.lower().contains('hypersensibilité') or display.lower().contains('hypersensibilite')) and display.lower().contains('intolérance').not() and display.lower().contains('intolerance').not() -> allergy.type = 'allergy' "typeAllergy";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where (allergyTypeCode.code != '416098002') and (display.lower().contains('médicament') or display.lower().contains('medicament') or display.lower().contains('médicamenteuse') or display.lower().contains('medicamenteuse')) -> allergy.category = 'medication' "categoryMedicationByDisplay";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where display.lower().contains('alimentaire') or display.lower().contains('aliment') or display.lower().contains('nourriture') -> allergy.category = 'food' "categoryFood";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where display.lower().contains('environnement') or display.lower().contains('pollen') or display.lower().contains('poussière') or display.lower().contains('poussiere') or display.lower().contains('latex') -> allergy.category = 'environment' "categoryEnvironment";
    allergyTypeCode.displayName as display where display.lower().contains('biologique') or display.lower().contains('vaccin') or display.lower().contains('sérum') or display.lower().contains('serum') -> allergy.category = 'biologic' "categoryBiologic";
  } "typeAndCategory";
  // Date de début.
  observation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.low as low -> allergy.onset = create('dateTime') as onsetDateTime then TSDateTime(low, onsetDateTime) "onsetDateTime";
  };
  // Sous-observations.
  observation.entryRelationship as er then {
    // Statut clinique.
    er.observation as statusObs then {
      statusObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.30' then {
          statusObs.value as statusValue -> allergy.clinicalStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as clinicalStatus then {
            statusValue.originalText as originalText then {
              originalText.reference as ref then {
                ref.value as value -> clinicalStatus.text = cast(value, 'string') "textFromOriginalTextReference";
              };
              originalText.xmlText as txt where originalText.reference.empty() -> clinicalStatus.text = cast(txt, 'string') "textFromOriginalText";
            };
            statusValue.displayName as display where statusValue.originalText.empty() -> clinicalStatus.text = cast(display, 'string') "textFromDisplayName";
            statusValue.code as code where (code = 'active') or (code = 'actif') -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'active' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Active' "display";
            } "activeFromCode";
            statusValue.code as code where (code = 'inactive') or (code = 'inactif') -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'inactive' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Inactive' "display";
            } "inactiveFromCode";
            statusValue.code as code where (code = 'resolved') or (code = 'resolu') or (code = 'résolu') -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'resolved' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Resolved' "display";
            } "resolvedFromCode";
            statusValue.displayName as display where statusValue.code.empty() and display.lower().contains('actif') and display.lower().contains('inactif').not() -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'active' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Active' "display";
            } "activeFromText";
            statusValue.displayName as display where statusValue.code.empty() and display.lower().contains('inactif') -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'inactive' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Inactive' "display";
            } "inactiveFromText";
            statusValue.displayName as display where statusValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('résolu') or display.lower().contains('resolu')) -> clinicalStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              statusValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical' "system";
              statusValue -> coding.code = 'resolved' "code";
              statusValue -> coding.display = 'Resolved' "display";
            } "resolvedFromText";
            statusValue where statusValue.code.empty() and statusValue.displayName.empty() and statusValue.originalText.empty() -> clinicalStatus.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              statusValue -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              statusValue -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "clinicalStatusAbsentReason";
          } "clinicalStatus";
        } "clinicalStatusBlock";
      } "statusTemplate";
    } "statusBlock";
    // Statut clinique absent.
    er.observation as statusObs then {
      statusObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.30' then {
          statusObs where statusObs.value.empty() -> allergy.clinicalStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as clinicalStatus then {
            statusObs -> clinicalStatus.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              statusObs -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              statusObs -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "dataAbsentReason";
          } "clinicalStatusNoValue";
        } "clinicalStatusNoValueBlock";
      } "statusNoValueTemplate";
    } "statusNoValueBlock";
    // Criticité.
    er.observation as criticalityObs then {
      criticalityObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.172' then {
          criticalityObs.value as criticalityValue then {
            criticalityValue.code as code -> allergy.criticality = cast(code, 'code') "criticality";
          } "criticalityValue";
        } "criticality";
      } "criticalityTemplate";
    } "criticalityBlock";
    // Certitude.
    er.observation as certaintyObs then {
      certaintyObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.171' then {
          certaintyObs.value as certaintyValue -> allergy.verificationStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as verificationStatus then {
            certaintyValue.originalText as originalText then {
              originalText.reference as ref then {
                ref.value as value -> verificationStatus.text = cast(value, 'string') "textFromOriginalTextReference";
              };
              originalText.xmlText as txt where originalText.reference.empty() -> verificationStatus.text = cast(txt, 'string') "textFromOriginalText";
            };
            certaintyValue.displayName as display where certaintyValue.originalText.empty() -> verificationStatus.text = cast(display, 'string') "textFromDisplayName";
            certaintyValue.code as code where (code = 'confirmed') or (code = 'confirme') or (code = 'confirmé') -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'confirmed' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Confirmed' "display";
            } "confirmedFromCode";
            certaintyValue.code as code where (code = 'unconfirmed') or (code = 'non-confirme') or (code = 'non-confirmé') or (code = 'non confirme') or (code = 'non confirmé') -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'unconfirmed' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Unconfirmed' "display";
            } "unconfirmedFromCode";
            certaintyValue.code as code where (code = 'refuted') or (code = 'refute') or (code = 'réfuté') -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'refuted' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Refuted' "display";
            } "refutedFromCode";
            certaintyValue.code as code where (code = 'entered-in-error') or (code = 'erreur') -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'entered-in-error' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Entered in Error' "display";
            } "enteredInErrorFromCode";
            certaintyValue.displayName as display where certaintyValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('non confirmé') or display.lower().contains('non confirme')) -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'unconfirmed' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Unconfirmed' "display";
            } "unconfirmedFromText";
            certaintyValue.displayName as display where certaintyValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('confirmé') or display.lower().contains('confirme')) and display.lower().contains('non confirmé').not() and display.lower().contains('non confirme').not() -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'confirmed' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Confirmed' "display";
            } "confirmedFromText";
            certaintyValue.displayName as display where certaintyValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('réfuté') or display.lower().contains('refute')) -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'refuted' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Refuted' "display";
            } "refutedFromText";
            certaintyValue.displayName as display where certaintyValue.code.empty() and (display.lower().contains('erreur') or display.lower().contains('saisi par erreur')) -> verificationStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              certaintyValue -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification' "system";
              certaintyValue -> coding.code = 'entered-in-error' "code";
              certaintyValue -> coding.display = 'Entered in Error' "display";
            } "enteredInErrorFromText";
            certaintyValue where certaintyValue.code.empty() and certaintyValue.displayName.empty() and certaintyValue.originalText.empty() -> verificationStatus.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              certaintyValue -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              certaintyValue -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "verificationStatusAbsentReason";
          } "verificationStatus";
        } "verificationStatusBlock";
      } "certaintyTemplate";
    } "certaintyBlock";
    // Certitude absente.
    er.observation as certaintyObs then {
      certaintyObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.171' then {
          certaintyObs where certaintyObs.value.empty() -> allergy.verificationStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as verificationStatus then {
            certaintyObs -> verificationStatus.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              certaintyObs -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              certaintyObs -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "dataAbsentReason";
          } "verificationStatusNoValue";
        } "verificationStatusNoValueBlock";
      } "certaintyNoValueTemplate";
    } "certaintyNoValueBlock";
    // Réaction.
    er.observation as reactionObs then {
      reactionObs.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.37' -> allergy.reaction as reaction then {
          observation.participant as participant then {
            participant.participantRole as participantRole then {
              participantRole.playingEntity as playingEntity then {
                playingEntity.code as substanceCode -> reaction.substance = create('CodeableConcept') as substance then CDCodeableConcept(substanceCode, substance) "substance";
              };
            };
          } "reactionSubstance";
          reactionObs.value as manifestationValue -> reaction.manifestation = create('CodeableConcept') as manifestation then CDCodeableConcept(manifestationValue, manifestation) "manifestation";
          reactionObs.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
            effectiveTime.low as low -> reaction.onset = create('dateTime') as onsetDateTime then TSDateTime(low, onsetDateTime) "reactionOnset";
          } "reactionEffectiveTime";
          reactionObs.entryRelationship as reactionEr then {
            reactionEr.observation as severityObs then {
              severityObs.templateId as severityTid then {
                severityTid.root as severityRoot where severityRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.29' then {
                  severityObs.value as severityValue where severityValue.code = '255604002' -> reaction.severity = 'mild' "severityMild";
                  severityObs.value as severityValue where severityValue.code = '6736007' -> reaction.severity = 'moderate' "severityModerate";
                  severityObs.value as severityValue where severityValue.code = '24484000' -> reaction.severity = 'severe' "severitySevere";
                } "reactionSeverity";
              } "severityTemplate";
            } "severityObservation";
          } "reactionEntryRelationships";
        } "reaction";
      } "reactionTemplate";
    } "reactionBlock";
  } "entryRelationships";
  // Référence dans la section FHIR.
  observation ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %allergy.id) "sectionEntry";
}

// 3. PROCÉDURES / ACTES
group PatientSummaryProcedureSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Section actes / procédures.
  section.templateId as sectionTid then {
    sectionTid.root as sectionRoot where sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.136' then {
      section.entry as entry then {
        entry.procedure as cdaProcedure then {
          cdaProcedure.templateId as procTid then {
            procTid.root as procRoot where procRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.62' ->  bundle.entry as procedureEntry,  procedureEntry.resource = create('Procedure') as fhirProcedure,  fhirProcedure.id = uuid(),  procedureEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id) then PatientSummaryProcedureFromProcedure(cdaProcedure, fhirProcedure, compSection, patient, bundle) "procedure";
          } "procedureTemplate";
        } "cdaProcedure";
      } "sectionEntry";
    } "historyActsSection";
  } "sectionTemplate";
}

// Acte CDA -> Procedure FHIR
group PatientSummaryProcedureFromProcedure(source procedure, target fhirProcedure : Procedure, target compSection, target patient : Patient, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // Statut.
  procedure -> fhirProcedure.status = 'unknown' "statusDefault";
  procedure.statusCode as statusCode then {
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'completed' "completed";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'in-progress' "active";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'stopped' "aborted";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'not-done' "cancelled";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'on-hold' "suspended";
  } "status";
  procedure.moodCode as mood where mood = 'INT' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'preparation' "statusIntent";
  // Identifiant, patient et code de l’acte.
  procedure.id as procedureId -> fhirProcedure.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(procedureId, identifier) "identifier";
  procedure ->  fhirProcedure.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  procedure.code as procedureCode -> fhirProcedure.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then CDCodeableConcept(procedureCode, code);
  // Date ou période de réalisation.
  procedure.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> fhirProcedure.performed = create('dateTime') as performedDateTime then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, performedDateTime) "performedDateTime";
    effectiveTime.low as low -> fhirProcedure.performed = create('Period') as performedPeriod then {
      low -> performedPeriod.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> performedPeriod.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    } "performedPeriod";
  } "performed";
  // Site anatomique.
  procedure.targetSiteCode as targetSiteCode -> fhirProcedure.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as bodySite then CDCodeableConcept(targetSiteCode, bodySite) "targetSite";
  procedure.approachSiteCode as approachSiteCode -> fhirProcedure.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as approachSite then CDCodeableConcept(approachSiteCode, approachSite) "approachSite";
  // Auteur et exécutant.
  procedure.author as author then {
    author.assignedAuthor as assignedAuthor then ProcedureRecorderFromAssignedAuthor(assignedAuthor, fhirProcedure, bundle) "recorder";
  };
  procedure.performer as performer then {
    performer.assignedEntity as assignedEntity then ProcedurePerformerFromAssignedEntity(assignedEntity, fhirProcedure, bundle) "performer";
  };
  // Informations complémentaires.
  procedure.entryRelationship as er then {
    // Motif de l’acte.
    er.act as reasonAct where er.typeCode = 'RSON' then {
      reasonAct.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36' then {
          reasonAct.code as reasonCode -> fhirProcedure.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as reason then CDCodeableConcept(reasonCode, reason) "reasonCode";
        } "reason";
      } "reasonTemplate";
    } "reasonAct";
    // Commentaire non mappé pour l’instant.
    er.act as commentAct where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
      commentAct.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' "commentNotMapped";
      } "commentTemplate";
    } "commentAct";
    // Dispositif médical utilisé.
    er.act as deviceReferenceAct where er.typeCode = 'REFR' then {
      deviceReferenceAct.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36' then {
          deviceReferenceAct.id as deviceId ->  fhirProcedure.usedReference = create('Reference') as usedRef,  usedRef.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(deviceId, identifier) "usedReference";
        } "deviceReference";
      } "deviceReferenceTemplate";
    } "deviceReferenceAct";
    // Observation liée à l’acte.
    er.observation as linkedObservation then {
      linkedObservation.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.48' ->  bundle.entry as obsEntry,  obsEntry.resource = create('Observation') as observation,  observation.id = uuid(),  obsEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %observation.id) then {
          linkedObservation -> observation.status = 'final' "observationStatus";
          linkedObservation.id as id -> observation.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "observationIdentifier";
          linkedObservation ->  observation.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "observationSubject";
          linkedObservation -> observation.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then {
            linkedObservation -> category.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
              linkedObservation -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "categorySystem";
              linkedObservation -> coding.code = 'procedure' "categoryCode";
              linkedObservation -> coding.display = 'Procedure' "categoryDisplay";
            } "categoryCoding";
          } "category";
          linkedObservation.code as code -> observation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as cc then CDCodeableConcept(code, cc) "observationCode";
          linkedObservation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime(effectiveTime, observation);
          linkedObservation where linkedObservation.effectiveTime.empty() -> observation.effective = create('dateTime') as effectiveDateTime then {
            linkedObservation -> effectiveDateTime.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              linkedObservation -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              linkedObservation -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "dataAbsentReason";
          } "effectiveTimeAbsentReason";
          linkedObservation.value as value -> observation.value = create('CodeableConcept') as cc then CDCodeableConcept(value, cc) "observationValue";
          linkedObservation ->  fhirProcedure.partOf = create('Reference') as partOfRef,  partOfRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %observation.id) "partOf";
        } "linkedObservationResource";
      } "linkedObservationTemplate";
    } "linkedObservation";
  };
  // Référence dans la section FHIR.
  procedure ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id) "sectionEntry";
}

// Auteur CDA -> recorder Procedure
group ProcedureRecorderFromAssignedAuthor(source assignedAuthor, target fhirProcedure : Procedure, target bundle : Bundle) {
  assignedAuthor ->  bundle.entry as practitionerEntry,  practitionerEntry.resource = create('Practitioner') as practitioner,  practitioner.id = uuid(),  practitionerEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) then {
    assignedAuthor then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner(assignedAuthor, practitioner) "practitionerBase";
    assignedAuthor then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner(assignedAuthor, practitioner) "practitionerFR";
    assignedAuthor.representedOrganization as representedOrganization ->  bundle.entry as organizationEntry,  organizationEntry.resource = create('Organization') as organization,  organization.id = uuid(),  organizationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %organization.id),  bundle.entry as roleEntry,  roleEntry.resource = create('PractitionerRole') as practitionerRole,  practitionerRole.id = uuid(),  roleEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) then {
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationBase";
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationFR";
      assignedAuthor then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole(assignedAuthor, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleBase";
      assignedAuthor then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole(assignedAuthor, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleFR";
      assignedAuthor ->  fhirProcedure.recorder = create('Reference') as recorderRef,  recorderRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) "recorderRole";
    } "withOrganization";
    assignedAuthor where assignedAuthor.representedOrganization.empty() ->  fhirProcedure.recorder = create('Reference') as recorderRef,  recorderRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) "recorderPractitionerOnly";
  } "recorder";
}

// Performer CDA -> performer Procedure
group ProcedurePerformerFromAssignedEntity(source assignedEntity, target fhirProcedure : Procedure, target bundle : Bundle) {
  assignedEntity ->  bundle.entry as practitionerEntry,  practitionerEntry.resource = create('Practitioner') as practitioner,  practitioner.id = uuid(),  practitionerEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) then {
    assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner(assignedEntity, practitioner) "practitionerBase";
    assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner(assignedEntity, practitioner) "practitionerFR";
    assignedEntity.representedOrganization as representedOrganization ->  bundle.entry as organizationEntry,  organizationEntry.resource = create('Organization') as organization,  organization.id = uuid(),  organizationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %organization.id),  bundle.entry as roleEntry,  roleEntry.resource = create('PractitionerRole') as practitionerRole,  practitionerRole.id = uuid(),  roleEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) then {
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationBase";
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationFR";
      assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole(assignedEntity, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleBase";
      assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole(assignedEntity, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleFR";
      assignedEntity ->  fhirProcedure.performer as performer,  performer.actor = create('Reference') as actorRef,  actorRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) "performerRole";
    } "withOrganization";
    assignedEntity where assignedEntity.representedOrganization.empty() ->  fhirProcedure.performer as performer,  performer.actor = create('Reference') as actorRef,  actorRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) "performerPractitionerOnly";
  } "performer";
}

// 4. TRAITEMENTS
group PatientSummaryMedicationSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Section traitements.
  section.templateId as sectionTid then {
    sectionTid.root as sectionRoot where sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.143' then {
      section.entry as entry then {
        entry.substanceAdministration as substanceAdministration then {
          substanceAdministration.templateId as treatmentTid then {
            treatmentTid.root as treatmentRoot where treatmentRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42' ->  bundle.entry as medicationStatementEntry,  medicationStatementEntry.resource = create('MedicationStatement') as medicationStatement,  medicationStatement.id = uuid(),  medicationStatementEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id) then PatientSummaryMedicationStatementFromSubstanceAdministration(substanceAdministration, medicationStatement, compSection, bundle, patient) "medicationStatement";
          } "treatmentTemplate";
        };
      };
    } "medicationSection";
  } "sectionTemplate";
}

// Administration CDA -> MedicationStatement
group PatientSummaryMedicationStatementFromSubstanceAdministration(source substanceAdministration, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut, patient et catégorie.
  substanceAdministration -> medicationStatement.status = 'unknown' "statusDefault";
  substanceAdministration.statusCode as statusCode then MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus(statusCode, medicationStatement) "status";
  substanceAdministration.id as id -> medicationStatement.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  substanceAdministration ->  medicationStatement.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  substanceAdministration.code as treatmentCode -> medicationStatement.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then CDCodeableConcept(treatmentCode, category) "category";
  // Médicament, période et posologie.
  substanceAdministration.consumable as consumable then MedicationResourceFromConsumable(consumable, medicationStatement, bundle) "medication";
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then MedicationStatementEffectiveFromEffectiveTime(effectiveTime, medicationStatement) "effective";
  substanceAdministration then MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration(substanceAdministration, medicationStatement) "mainDosage";
  // Motif et commentaire.
  substanceAdministration.entryRelationship as er then MedicationEntryRelationship(er, medicationStatement);
  // Posologies subordonnées.
  substanceAdministration.entryRelationship as er where er.typeCode = 'COMP' then {
    er.substanceAdministration as childAdministration -> medicationStatement.dosage as childDosage then MedicationChildDosageFromSubstanceAdministration(childAdministration, substanceAdministration, childDosage) "childDosage";
  } "childTreatment";
  // Référence dans la section FHIR.
  substanceAdministration ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id) "sectionEntry";
}

// Statut CDA -> MedicationStatement.status
group MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus(source statusCode, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement) {
  statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> medicationStatement.status = 'completed' "completed";
  statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> medicationStatement.status = 'active' "active";
  statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> medicationStatement.status = 'stopped' "aborted";
  statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> medicationStatement.status = 'stopped' "cancelled";
  statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> medicationStatement.status = 'on-hold' "suspended";
}

// Produit de santé CDA -> Medication + référence depuis MedicationStatement
group MedicationResourceFromConsumable(source consumable, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement, target bundle : Bundle) {
  consumable.manufacturedProduct as manufacturedProduct then {
    manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial as manufacturedMaterial ->  bundle.entry as medicationEntry,  medicationEntry.resource = create('Medication') as medication,  medication.id = uuid(),  medicationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %medication.id) then {
      manufacturedMaterial then MedicationFromManufacturedMaterial(manufacturedMaterial, medication) "medicationContent";
      manufacturedMaterial ->  medicationStatement.medication = create('Reference') as medicationRef,  medicationRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %medication.id) "medicationReference";
    } "medication";
  };
}

// Contenu du médicament
group MedicationFromManufacturedMaterial(source manufacturedMaterial, target medication : Medication) {
  manufacturedMaterial.code as medicationCode -> medication.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then CDCodeableConcept(medicationCode, code);
  manufacturedMaterial.name as medicationName where manufacturedMaterial.code.empty() -> medication.code = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
    medicationName.xmlText as nameText -> code.text = cast(nameText, 'string') "codeText";
  } "nameOnly";
  manufacturedMaterial.pharm:formCode as formCode -> medication.form = create('CodeableConcept') as form then CDCodeableConcept(formCode, form) "form";
  manufacturedMaterial.pharm:ingredient as ingredient then MedicationIngredientFromPharmIngredient(ingredient, medication) "ingredient";
}

// Ingrédient pharmaceutique
group MedicationIngredientFromPharmIngredient(source ingredient, target medication : Medication) {
  ingredient.pharm:ingredient as innerIngredient then {
    innerIngredient.pharm:code as ingredientCode ->  medication.ingredient as fhirIngredient,  fhirIngredient.item = create('CodeableConcept') as item then {
      ingredientCode then CDCodeableConcept(ingredientCode, item) "ingredientCode";
      ingredient.pharm:quantity as quantity then MedicationIngredientStrengthFromPharmQuantity(quantity, fhirIngredient) "strength";
    } "ingredient";
  } "innerIngredient";
}

// Dosage de l’ingrédient
group MedicationIngredientStrengthFromPharmQuantity(source quantity, target fhirIngredient) {
  quantity.numerator as numerator -> fhirIngredient.strength = create('Ratio') as strength then {
    numerator -> strength.numerator = create('Quantity') as numeratorQuantity then {
      numerator.value as value -> numeratorQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "numeratorValue";
      numerator.unit as unit -> numeratorQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "numeratorUnit";
    } "numerator";
    quantity.denominator as denominator -> strength.denominator = create('Quantity') as denominatorQuantity then {
      denominator.value as value -> denominatorQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "denominatorValue";
      denominator.unit as unit -> denominatorQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "denominatorUnit";
    };
  } "strength";
}

// Période du traitement
group MedicationStatementEffectiveFromEffectiveTime(source effectiveTime, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement) {
  effectiveTime.low as low -> medicationStatement.effective = create('Period') as period then {
    low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
    effectiveTime.high as high then {
      high.value as value -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    };
  } "periodByLow";
  effectiveTime.high as high where effectiveTime.low.empty() then {
    high.value as value -> medicationStatement.effective = create('Period') as period then {
      high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "endOnly";
    } "period";
  } "periodByHigh";
}

// Création conditionnelle du dosage principal
group MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration(source substanceAdministration, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement) {
  substanceAdministration.routeCode as routeCode -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByRoute";
  substanceAdministration.doseQuantity as doseQuantity where substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() then {
    doseQuantity.low as low -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByDoseLow";
    doseQuantity.high as high where doseQuantity.low.empty() -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByDoseHigh";
  } "dosageByDose";
  substanceAdministration.rateQuantity as rateQuantity where substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty() then {
    rateQuantity.low as low -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByRateLow";
    rateQuantity.high as high where rateQuantity.low.empty() -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByRateHigh";
  } "dosageByRate";
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime as effectiveTime where substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty() and substanceAdministration.rateQuantity.empty() then {
    effectiveTime.period as period -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByTiming";
  } "dosageByTiming";
  substanceAdministration.maxDoseQuantity as maxDoseQuantity where substanceAdministration.routeCode.empty() and substanceAdministration.doseQuantity.empty() and substanceAdministration.rateQuantity.empty() then {
    maxDoseQuantity.numerator as numerator then {
      numerator.value as value -> medicationStatement.dosage as dosage then MedicationMainDosageContent(substanceAdministration, dosage) "dosageByMaxDose";
    };
  } "dosageByMaxDose";
}

// Contenu du dosage
group MedicationMainDosageContent(source substanceAdministration, target dosage) {
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then MedicationDosageTimingFromEffectiveTime(effectiveTime, dosage) "timing";
  substanceAdministration.routeCode as routeCode -> dosage.route = create('CodeableConcept') as route then CDCodeableConcept(routeCode, route) "route";
  substanceAdministration.doseQuantity as doseQuantity then MedicationDosageDoseFromDoseQuantity(doseQuantity, dosage) "dose";
  substanceAdministration.rateQuantity as rateQuantity then MedicationDosageRateFromRateQuantity(rateQuantity, dosage) "rate";
  substanceAdministration.maxDoseQuantity as maxDoseQuantity then MedicationDosageMaxDoseFromMaxDoseQuantity(maxDoseQuantity, dosage) "maxDose";
}

// Fréquence / rythme
group MedicationDosageTimingFromEffectiveTime(source effectiveTime, target dosage) {
  effectiveTime.period as period -> dosage.timing = create('Timing') as timing then {
    period -> timing.repeat as repeat then {
      period.value as value -> repeat.period = cast(value, 'decimal') "periodValue";
      period.unit as unit -> repeat.periodUnit = cast(unit, 'code') "periodUnit";
    } "repeat";
    period.translation as translation then {
      translation.originalText as originalText then {
        originalText.reference as ref then {
          ref.value as value -> dosage.text = cast(value, 'string') "dosageText";
        };
      };
    };
  } "timing";
}

// Dose
group MedicationDosageDoseFromDoseQuantity(source doseQuantity, target dosage) {
  doseQuantity.low as low ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.dose = create('Range') as doseRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(doseQuantity, doseRange) "doseRangeByLow";
  doseQuantity.high as high where doseQuantity.low.empty() ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.dose = create('Range') as doseRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(doseQuantity, doseRange) "doseRangeByHigh";
}

// Rythme / débit
group MedicationDosageRateFromRateQuantity(source rateQuantity, target dosage) {
  rateQuantity.low as low ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.rate = create('Range') as rateRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(rateQuantity, rateRange) "rateRangeByLow";
  rateQuantity.high as high where rateQuantity.low.empty() ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.rate = create('Range') as rateRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(rateQuantity, rateRange) "rateRangeByHigh";
}

// Dose maximale
group MedicationDosageMaxDoseFromMaxDoseQuantity(source maxDoseQuantity, target dosage) {
  maxDoseQuantity.numerator as numerator then {
    numerator.value as value -> dosage.maxDosePerPeriod = create('Ratio') as ratio then MedicationRatioFromNumeratorDenominator(maxDoseQuantity, ratio) "maxDose";
  };
}

// Range low/high
group MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(source srcQuantity, target range : Range) {
  srcQuantity.low as low then {
    low.value as value -> range.low = create('Quantity') as lowQuantity then {
      value -> lowQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "lowValue";
      low.unit as unit -> lowQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "lowUnit";
    } "lowQuantity";
  };
  srcQuantity.high as high then {
    high.value as value -> range.high = create('Quantity') as highQuantity then {
      value -> highQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "highValue";
      high.unit as unit -> highQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "highUnit";
    } "highQuantity";
  };
}

// Ratio numerator/denominator
group MedicationRatioFromNumeratorDenominator(source srcRatio, target ratio : Ratio) {
  srcRatio.numerator as numerator then {
    numerator.value as value -> ratio.numerator = create('Quantity') as numeratorQuantity then {
      value -> numeratorQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "numeratorValue";
      numerator.unit as unit -> numeratorQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "numeratorUnit";
    } "numeratorQuantity";
  };
  srcRatio.denominator as denominator then {
    denominator.value as value -> ratio.denominator = create('Quantity') as denominatorQuantity then {
      value -> denominatorQuantity.value = cast(value, 'decimal') "denominatorValue";
      denominator.unit as unit -> denominatorQuantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "denominatorUnit";
    } "denominatorQuantity";
  };
}

// Motif et commentaire
group MedicationEntryRelationship(source er, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement) {
  er.act as reasonAct where er.typeCode = 'RSON' then {
    reasonAct.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.36' then MedicationReasonFromAct(reasonAct, medicationStatement) "reason";
    } "reasonTemplate";
  } "reasonAct";
  er.act as commentAct where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
    commentAct.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' "commentNotMapped";
    } "commentTemplate";
  } "commentAct";
}

// Motif du traitement
group MedicationReasonFromAct(source reasonAct, target medicationStatement : MedicationStatement) {
  reasonAct.code as reasonCode -> medicationStatement.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as reason then CDCodeableConcept(reasonCode, reason) "reasonCode";
}

// Posologie subordonnée
group MedicationChildDosageFromSubstanceAdministration(source childAdministration, source parentAdministration, target childDosage) {
  childAdministration.effectiveTime as childEffectiveTime then MedicationChildTimingFromEffectiveTime(childEffectiveTime, childDosage) "childTiming";
  parentAdministration.routeCode as routeCode -> childDosage.route = create('CodeableConcept') as route then CDCodeableConcept(routeCode, route) "childRoute";
  childAdministration.doseQuantity as doseQuantity then MedicationDosageDoseFromDoseQuantity(doseQuantity, childDosage) "childDose";
  childAdministration.rateQuantity as rateQuantity then MedicationDosageRateFromRateQuantity(rateQuantity, childDosage) "childRate";
}

// Rythme de la posologie subordonnée
group MedicationChildTimingFromEffectiveTime(source childEffectiveTime, target childDosage) {
  childEffectiveTime -> childDosage.timing = create('Timing') as timing then {
    childEffectiveTime -> timing.repeat as repeat then {
      childEffectiveTime.comp as comp then {
        comp.low as low -> repeat.bounds = create('Period') as boundsPeriod then {
          low -> boundsPeriod.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "boundsStart";
        } "bounds";
        comp.period as period then {
          period.value as value -> repeat.period = cast(value, 'decimal') "periodValue";
          period.unit as unit -> repeat.periodUnit = cast(unit, 'code') "periodUnit";
          period.translation as translation then {
            translation.originalText as originalText then {
              originalText.reference as ref then {
                ref.value as value -> childDosage.text = cast(value, 'string') "childDosageText";
              };
            };
          };
        };
      };
    } "repeat";
  } "timing";
}

// 5. EFFETS INDÉSIRABLES MÉDICAMENTEUX
group PatientSummaryAdverseDrugReactionSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Section effets indésirables.
  section.templateId as sectionTid then {
    sectionTid.root as sectionRoot where sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.247' then {
      section.entry as entry then {
        entry.observation as adverseObservation then {
          adverseObservation.templateId as tid then {
            tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.210' ->  bundle.entry as adverseEntry,  adverseEntry.resource = create('AdverseEvent') as adverseEvent,  adverseEvent.id = uuid(),  adverseEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %adverseEvent.id) then PatientSummaryAdverseEventFromObservation(adverseObservation, adverseEvent, compSection, bundle, patient) "adverseEvent";
          } "adverseTemplate";
        } "adverseObservation";
      };
    } "adverseSection";
  } "sectionTemplate";
}

// Observation CDA -> AdverseEvent
group PatientSummaryAdverseEventFromObservation(source adverseObservation, target adverseEvent : AdverseEvent, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut, identifiant et patient.
  adverseObservation -> adverseEvent.actuality = 'actual' "actualityDefault";
  adverseObservation.moodCode as mood where mood = 'INT' -> adverseEvent.actuality = 'potential' "actualityPotential";
  adverseObservation.id as id -> adverseEvent.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  adverseObservation ->  adverseEvent.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Catégorie de l’effet indésirable.
  adverseObservation.code as code -> adverseEvent.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then {
    code then CDCodeableConcept(code, category) "categoryCoding";
    adverseObservation.text as text then {
      text.reference as reference then {
        reference.value as value -> category.text = cast(value, 'string') "categoryText";
      };
    };
  } "category";
  // Dates.
  adverseObservation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.low as low -> adverseEvent.date = create('dateTime') as date then TSDateTime(low, date) "date";
    effectiveTime.high as high then {
      high.value as value -> adverseEvent.detected = create('dateTime') as detected then TSDateTime(high, detected) "detected";
    } "detected";
  } "dates";
  // Informations complémentaires.
  adverseObservation.entryRelationship as er then {
    // Traitement suspect.
    er.substanceAdministration as treatment where er.typeCode = 'COMP' then {
      treatment.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42' then AdverseEventSuspectMedicationFromTreatment(treatment, adverseObservation, adverseEvent, bundle, patient) "suspectMedication";
      } "treatmentTemplate";
    } "treatment";
    // Réaction observée.
    er.observation as reactionObservation where er.typeCode = 'MFST' then {
      reactionObservation.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.37' then AdverseEventResultingConditionFromReaction(reactionObservation, adverseEvent, bundle, patient) "reaction";
      } "reactionTemplate";
    } "reaction";
    // Gravité.
    er.observation as seriousnessObservation where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
      seriousnessObservation.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.212' then {
          seriousnessObservation.value as value -> adverseEvent.seriousness = create('CodeableConcept') as seriousness then CDCodeableConcept(value, seriousness) "seriousness";
        } "seriousness";
      } "seriousnessTemplate";
    } "seriousness";
    // Évolution.
    er.observation as outcomeObservation where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
      outcomeObservation.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.213' then {
          outcomeObservation.value as value -> adverseEvent.outcome = create('CodeableConcept') as outcome then CDCodeableConcept(value, outcome) "outcome";
        } "outcome";
      } "outcomeTemplate";
    } "outcome";
    // Commentaire non mappé pour l’instant.
    er.act as commentAct where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
      commentAct.templateId as tid then {
        tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' "commentNotMapped";
      } "commentTemplate";
    } "comment";
  };
  // Référence dans la section FHIR.
  adverseObservation ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %adverseEvent.id) "sectionEntry";
}

// Traitement suspect -> MedicationStatement + suspectEntity
group AdverseEventSuspectMedicationFromTreatment(source treatment, source adverseObservation, target adverseEvent : AdverseEvent, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  treatment ->  bundle.entry as medicationStatementEntry,  medicationStatementEntry.resource = create('MedicationStatement') as medicationStatement,  medicationStatement.id = uuid(),  medicationStatementEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id) then {
    // MedicationStatement lié au médicament suspect.
    treatment -> medicationStatement.status = 'unknown' "statusDefault";
    treatment.statusCode as statusCode then MedicationStatementStatusFromCdaStatus(statusCode, medicationStatement) "status";
    treatment.id as id -> medicationStatement.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
    treatment ->  medicationStatement.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
    treatment.code as treatmentCode -> medicationStatement.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then CDCodeableConcept(treatmentCode, category) "category";
    treatment.consumable as consumable then MedicationResourceFromConsumable(consumable, medicationStatement, bundle) "medication";
    treatment.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then MedicationStatementEffectiveFromEffectiveTime(effectiveTime, medicationStatement) "effective";
    treatment then MedicationMainDosageFromSubstanceAdministration(treatment, medicationStatement) "dosage";
    // Lien avec AdverseEvent.suspectEntity.
    treatment ->  adverseEvent.suspectEntity as suspectEntity,  suspectEntity.instance = create('Reference') as instanceRef,  instanceRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationStatement.id) then {
      // Imputabilité.
      adverseObservation.entryRelationship as causalityEr then {
        causalityEr.observation as causalityObservation where causalityEr.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
          causalityObservation.templateId as tid then {
            tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.211' then {
              causalityObservation.value as value ->  suspectEntity.causality as causality,  causality.assessment = create('CodeableConcept') as assessment then CDCodeableConcept(value, assessment) "causalityAssessment";
            } "causality";
          } "causalityTemplate";
        } "causalityObservation";
      } "causality";
    } "suspectEntity";
  } "suspectMedication";
}

// Réaction observée -> Condition + resultingCondition
group AdverseEventResultingConditionFromReaction(source reactionObservation, target adverseEvent : AdverseEvent, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  reactionObservation ->  bundle.entry as conditionEntry,  conditionEntry.resource = create('Condition') as condition,  condition.id = uuid(),  conditionEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %condition.id) then {
    // Condition liée à la réaction.
    reactionObservation.id as id -> condition.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
    reactionObservation ->  condition.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
    reactionObservation.code as code -> condition.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then CDCodeableConcept(code, category) "category";
    reactionObservation.value as value -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as conditionCode then CDCodeableConcept(value, conditionCode) "code";
    reactionObservation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
      effectiveTime.low as low -> condition.onset = create('dateTime') as onset then TSDateTime(low, onset) "onset";
      effectiveTime.high as high then {
        high.value as value -> condition.abatement = create('dateTime') as abatement then TSDateTime(high, abatement) "abatement";
      } "abatement";
    };
    // Lien avec AdverseEvent.resultingCondition.
    reactionObservation ->  adverseEvent.resultingCondition = create('Reference') as conditionRef,  conditionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %condition.id) "resultingCondition";
  } "reactionCondition";
}

// 6. VACCINATIONS
group PatientSummaryImmunizationSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Section vaccinations.
  section.templateId as sectionTid then {
    sectionTid.root as sectionRoot where sectionRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.2.147' then {
      section.entry as entry then {
        entry.substanceAdministration as substanceAdministration then {
          substanceAdministration.templateId as immunizationTid then {
            immunizationTid.root as immunizationRoot where immunizationRoot = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.45' ->  bundle.entry as immunizationEntry,  immunizationEntry.resource = create('Immunization') as immunization,  immunization.id = uuid(),  immunizationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %immunization.id) then PatientSummaryImmunizationFromSubstanceAdministration(substanceAdministration, immunization, compSection, bundle, patient) "immunization";
          } "immunizationTemplate";
        };
      };
    } "vaccinationSection";
  } "sectionTemplate";
}

// substanceAdministration CDA -> Immunization
group PatientSummaryImmunizationFromSubstanceAdministration(source substanceAdministration, target immunization : Immunization, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut, identifiant, patient et date.
  substanceAdministration -> immunization.status = 'completed' "statusDefault";
  substanceAdministration.negationInd as negation where negation = 'true' -> immunization.status = 'not-done' "statusNotDoneByNegation";
  substanceAdministration.statusCode as statusCode then {
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> immunization.status = 'completed' "completed";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> immunization.status = 'not-done' "aborted";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> immunization.status = 'not-done' "cancelled";
  } "status";
  substanceAdministration.id as id -> immunization.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  substanceAdministration ->  immunization.patient = create('Reference') as patientRef,  patientRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "patient";
  substanceAdministration.effectiveTime as effectiveTime -> immunization.occurrence = create('dateTime') as occurrenceDateTime then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, occurrenceDateTime) "occurrenceDateTime";
  // Vaccin et numéro de lot.
  substanceAdministration.consumable as consumable then {
    consumable.manufacturedProduct as manufacturedProduct then {
      manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial as manufacturedMaterial then {
        manufacturedMaterial.code as vaccineCode -> immunization.vaccineCode = create('CodeableConcept') as code then {
