      id.extension as extension -> memberRef.reference = ('#' + extension) "memberReferenceExtension";
      id.root as root where id.extension.empty() -> memberRef.reference = ('urn:oid:' + root) "memberReferenceRoot";
    } "memberId";
  } "hasMember";
}

group ResultObservationNoteFromCommentAct(source commentAct, target resultObservation : Observation) {
  commentAct.templateId as tid then {
    tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' then {
      commentAct.text as text then {
        text.reference as reference then {
          reference.value as value ->  resultObservation.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(value, 'string') "noteReference";
        };
      };
    } "commentTemplate";
  };
}

group ResultObservationReferenceRangeFromCdaReferenceRange(source referenceRange, target resultObservation : Observation) {
  referenceRange.observationRange as observationRange -> resultObservation.referenceRange as fhirReferenceRange then {
    observationRange.text as text then {
      text.xmlText as xml -> fhirReferenceRange.text = cast(xml, 'string') "referenceRangeText";
    };
    observationRange.value as value then {
      value.low as low -> fhirReferenceRange.low = create('Quantity') as lowQuantity then {
        low.value as lowValue -> lowQuantity.value = cast(lowValue, 'decimal') "lowValue";
        low.unit as lowUnit -> lowQuantity.unit = cast(lowUnit, 'string') "lowUnit";
      };
      value.high as high -> fhirReferenceRange.high = create('Quantity') as highQuantity then {
        high.value as highValue -> highQuantity.value = cast(highValue, 'decimal') "highValue";
        high.unit as highUnit -> highQuantity.unit = cast(highUnit, 'string') "highUnit";
      };
    };
  } "referenceRange";
}

// 7.5 FACTEURS DE RISQUES PROFESSIONNELS
group PatientSummaryProfessionalRisksSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  section.entry as entry then {
    entry.observation as observation ->  bundle.entry as observationEntry,  observationEntry.resource = create('Observation') as fhirObservation,  fhirObservation.id = uuid(),  observationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirObservation.id) then {
      observation then PatientSummaryProfessionalRiskObservationFromObservation(observation, fhirObservation, patient) "professionalRiskObservation";
      observation then ObservationAddToSection(observation, fhirObservation, compSection) "sectionEntry";
    } "directObservation";
    entry.organizer as organizer then {
      organizer.component as component then {
        component.observation as observation ->  bundle.entry as observationEntry,  observationEntry.resource = create('Observation') as fhirObservation,  fhirObservation.id = uuid(),  observationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirObservation.id) then {
          observation then PatientSummaryProfessionalRiskObservationFromObservation(observation, fhirObservation, patient) "professionalRiskComponentObservation";
          observation then ObservationAddToSection(observation, fhirObservation, compSection) "sectionEntry";
        } "componentObservation";
      };
    };
  };
}

group PatientSummaryProfessionalRiskObservationFromObservation(source observation, target fhirObservation : Observation, target patient : Patient) {
  observation -> fhirObservation.status = 'final' "statusDefault";
  observation.statusCode as statusCode then ObservationStatusFromCdaStatus(statusCode, fhirObservation) "status";
  observation.id as id -> fhirObservation.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  observation ->  fhirObservation.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  observation -> fhirObservation.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then {
    observation -> category.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
      observation -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category' "categorySystem";
      observation -> coding.code = 'social-history' "categoryCode";
      observation -> coding.display = 'Social History' "categoryDisplay";
    } "categoryCoding";
  } "category";
  observation.code as code -> fhirObservation.code = create('CodeableConcept') as obsCode then CDCodeableConcept(code, obsCode);
  observation.code as code then {
    code.qualifier as qualifier -> fhirObservation.component as component then ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentFromQualifier(qualifier, component) "qualifierComponent";
  } "qualifiers";
  observation.text as text then ProfessionalRiskObservationNoteFromText(text, fhirObservation) "textNote";
  observation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then ObservationEffectiveFromEffectiveTime(effectiveTime, fhirObservation);
  observation where observation.effectiveTime.empty() -> fhirObservation.effective = create('dateTime') as effectiveDateTime then {
    observation -> effectiveDateTime.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
      observation -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
      observation -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
    } "dataAbsentReason";
  } "effectiveTimeAbsentReason";
  observation.value as value then ProfessionalRiskObservationValueFromCdaValue(value, fhirObservation);
  observation.interpretationCode as interpretationCode -> fhirObservation.interpretation = create('CodeableConcept') as interpretation then CDCodeableConcept(interpretationCode, interpretation) "interpretation";
  observation.methodCode as methodCode -> fhirObservation.method = create('CodeableConcept') as method then CDCodeableConcept(methodCode, method) "method";
  observation.targetSiteCode as targetSiteCode -> fhirObservation.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as bodySite then CDCodeableConcept(targetSiteCode, bodySite) "bodySite";
  observation.entryRelationship as er then ObservationCommentFromEntryRelationship(er, fhirObservation) "comments";
}

group ProfessionalRiskObservationValueFromCdaValue(source value, target fhirObservation : Observation) {
  value.unit as unit -> fhirObservation.value = create('Quantity') as quantity then {
    value.value as v -> quantity.value = cast(v, 'decimal') "quantityValue";
    unit -> quantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "quantityUnit";
  } "valueQuantity";
  value.code as code where value.unit.empty() -> fhirObservation.value = create('CodeableConcept') as valueCodeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(value, valueCodeableConcept) "valueCodeableConcept";
  value.value as v where value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true') -> fhirObservation.value = cast(v, 'boolean') "valueBooleanTrue";
  value.value as v where value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'false') -> fhirObservation.value = cast(v, 'boolean') "valueBooleanFalse";
}

group ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentFromQualifier(source qualifier, target component) {
  qualifier.name as name -> component.code = create('CodeableConcept') as componentCode then CDCodeableConcept(name, componentCode) "componentCode";
  qualifier.value as value then ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue(value, component) "componentValue";
}

group ProfessionalRiskObservationComponentValueFromCdaValue(source value, target component) {
  value.unit as unit -> component.value = create('Quantity') as quantity then {
    value.value as v -> quantity.value = cast(v, 'decimal') "quantityValue";
    unit -> quantity.unit = cast(unit, 'string') "quantityUnit";
  } "componentValueQuantity";
  value.code as code where value.unit.empty() -> component.value = create('CodeableConcept') as valueCodeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(value, valueCodeableConcept) "componentValueCodeableConcept";
  value.value as v where value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'true') -> component.value = cast(v, 'boolean') "componentValueBooleanTrue";
  value.value as v where value.unit.empty() and value.code.empty() and (v = 'false') -> component.value = cast(v, 'boolean') "componentValueBooleanFalse";
}

group ProfessionalRiskObservationNoteFromText(source text, target fhirObservation : Observation) {
  text.reference as reference then {
    reference.value as value ->  fhirObservation.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(value, 'string') "noteReference";
  };
  text.xmlText as xml where text.reference.empty() ->  fhirObservation.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(xml, 'string') "noteText";
}

// 8. PLAN DE SOINS
group PatientSummaryCarePlanSection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // CarePlan.
  section ->  bundle.entry as carePlanEntry,  carePlanEntry.resource = create('CarePlan') as carePlan,  carePlan.id = uuid(),  carePlanEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %carePlan.id) then PSPlanCarePlan(section, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "carePlan";
}

group PSPlanCarePlan(source section, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut.
  section -> carePlan.status = 'active' "status";
  // Intention.
  section -> carePlan.intent = 'plan' "intent";
  // Patient.
  section ->  carePlan.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Identifiant.
  section.id as id -> carePlan.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Catégorie.
  section.code as code -> carePlan.category = create('CodeableConcept') as category then CDCodeableConcept(code, category) "category";
  // Titre.
  section.title as title -> carePlan.title = (title.xmlText);
  // Période.
  section.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> carePlan.created = create('dateTime') as created then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, created) "created";
    effectiveTime.low as low -> carePlan.period = create('Period') as period then {
      low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    } "period";
  };
  // Entrées du plan.
  section.entry as sectionEntry then PSPlanEntryDispatcher(sectionEntry, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "entries";
  // Référence section.
  section ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %carePlan.id) "sectionEntryCarePlan";
}

group PSPlanEntryDispatcher(source sectionEntry, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Traitement prévu.
  sectionEntry.substanceAdministration as sa then {
    sa.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.42' then PSPlanMedicationRequestEntry(sa, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "medicationRequest";
    } "templateTreatment";
  } "treatment";
  // Demande d’examen.
  sectionEntry.observation as obs then {
    obs.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.27' then PSPlanServiceRequestEntry(obs, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "serviceRequest";
    } "templateServiceRequest";
  } "serviceRequest";
  // Acte prévu.
  sectionEntry.procedure as proc then {
    proc.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.62' then PSPlanProcedureEntry(proc, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "procedure";
    } "templateProcedure";
  };
  // Rencontre prévue.
  sectionEntry.encounter as enc then {
    enc.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.58' then PSPlanEncounterEntry(enc, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "encounter";
    } "templateEncounter";
  };
  // Vaccin recommandé.
  sectionEntry.substanceAdministration as sa then {
    sa.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.47' then PSPlanImmunizationRecommendationEntry(sa, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "immunizationRecommendation";
    } "templateVaccineRecommendation";
  } "vaccineRecommendation";
}

// TRAITEMENT PRÉVU -> MedicationRequest
group PSPlanMedicationRequestEntry(source sa, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // MedicationRequest.
  sa ->  bundle.entry as medicationRequestEntry,  medicationRequestEntry.resource = create('MedicationRequest') as medicationRequest,  medicationRequest.id = uuid(),  medicationRequestEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationRequest.id) then PSPlanMedicationRequest(sa, medicationRequest, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "medicationRequest";
}

group PSPlanMedicationRequest(source sa, target medicationRequest : MedicationRequest, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut.
  sa -> medicationRequest.status = 'active' "statusDefault";
  sa.statusCode as statusCode then {
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> medicationRequest.status = 'active' "active";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> medicationRequest.status = 'completed' "completed";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> medicationRequest.status = 'stopped' "aborted";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> medicationRequest.status = 'cancelled' "cancelled";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> medicationRequest.status = 'on-hold' "suspended";
  } "status";
  // Intention.
  sa -> medicationRequest.intent = 'plan' "intentDefault";
  sa.moodCode as moodCode then {
    moodCode where moodCode = 'INT' -> medicationRequest.intent = 'plan' "intent";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'GOL' -> medicationRequest.intent = 'plan' "goal";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'PRP' -> medicationRequest.intent = 'proposal' "proposal";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'RQO' -> medicationRequest.intent = 'order' "order";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'ARQ' -> medicationRequest.intent = 'order' "appointmentRequest";
  } "intent";
  // Identifiant.
  sa.id as id -> medicationRequest.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Patient.
  sa ->  medicationRequest.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Médicament.
  sa.consumable as consumable then {
    consumable.manufacturedProduct as manufacturedProduct then {
      manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial as material then {
        // Médicament codé.
        material.code as medicationCode where medicationCode.code.empty().not() ->  bundle.entry as medicationEntry,  medicationEntry.resource = create('Medication') as medication,  medication.id = uuid(),  medicationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %medication.id) then {
          material.code as code -> medication.code = create('CodeableConcept') as medicationCodeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(code, medicationCodeableConcept) "medicationCode";
          material.name as name where material.code.empty() -> medication.code = create('CodeableConcept') as codeOnlyText then {
            name.xmlText as nameText -> codeOnlyText.text = cast(nameText, 'string') "nameText";
          } "nameOnly";
          material ->  medicationRequest.medication = create('Reference') as medicationRef,  medicationRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %medication.id) "medicationReference";
        } "codedMedication";
        // Médicament textuel.
        material.code as medicationCode where medicationCode.code.empty() -> medicationRequest.medication = create('CodeableConcept') as medicationCodeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(medicationCode, medicationCodeableConcept) "textOnlyMedication";
        // Nom du médicament.
        material.name as name where material.code.empty() -> medicationRequest.medication = create('CodeableConcept') as medicationCodeableConcept then {
          name.xmlText as nameText -> medicationCodeableConcept.text = cast(nameText, 'string') "medicationNameOnly";
        } "medicationNameOnly";
        // Traduction.
        material.code as medicationCode then {
          medicationCode.translation as translation -> medicationRequest.medication = create('CodeableConcept') as medicationCodeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(translation, medicationCodeableConcept) "translationMedication";
        } "translation";
      } "material";
    };
  } "medication";
  // Médicament absent.
  sa where sa.consumable.empty() -> medicationRequest.medication = create('CodeableConcept') as medicationAbsent then PSPlanCodeableConceptAbsentReason(sa, medicationAbsent) "medicationAbsent";
  // Note.
  sa.text as text then PSPlanTextToNote(text, medicationRequest);
  // Commentaire.
  sa.entryRelationship as er then PSPlanCommentToNote(er, medicationRequest) "comment";
  // Timing.
  sa.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.low as low -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
      low -> dosage.timing as timing then {
        low -> timing.repeat as repeat then {
          low -> repeat.bounds = create('Period') as period then {
            low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
            effectiveTime.high as high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
          } "bounds";
        } "repeat";
      } "timing";
    } "lowHigh";
    effectiveTime.period as period -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
      period -> dosage.timing as timing then {
        period -> timing.repeat as repeat then {
          period.value as value -> repeat.period = cast(value, 'decimal') "period";
          period.unit as unit -> repeat.periodUnit = cast(unit, 'code') "periodUnit";
        } "repeat";
      } "timing";
    } "frequency";
  } "timing";
  // Répétitions.
  sa.repeatNumber as repeatNumber then {
    repeatNumber.value as value -> medicationRequest.dispenseRequest as dispenseRequest then {
      value -> dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed = cast(value, 'integer') "numberOfRepeatsAllowed";
    } "dispenseRequest";
  };
  // Voie.
  sa.routeCode as routeCode -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
    routeCode -> dosage.route = create('CodeableConcept') as route then CDCodeableConcept(routeCode, route) "route";
  } "route";
  // Site.
  sa.approachSiteCode as siteCode -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
    siteCode -> dosage.site = create('CodeableConcept') as site then CDCodeableConcept(siteCode, site) "site";
  } "site";
  // Dose.
  sa.doseQuantity as doseQuantity then {
    doseQuantity.low as low -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
      doseQuantity ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.dose = create('Range') as doseRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(doseQuantity, doseRange) "doseRange";
    } "dose";
  };
  // Débit.
  sa.rateQuantity as rateQuantity then {
    rateQuantity.low as low -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
      rateQuantity ->  dosage.doseAndRate as doseAndRate,  doseAndRate.rate = create('Range') as rateRange then MedicationRangeFromLowHigh(rateQuantity, rateRange) "rateRange";
    } "rate";
  };
  // Dose maximale.
  sa.maxDoseQuantity as maxDoseQuantity then {
    maxDoseQuantity.numerator as numerator -> medicationRequest.dosageInstruction as dosage then {
      maxDoseQuantity -> dosage.maxDosePerPeriod = create('Ratio') as ratio then MedicationRatioFromNumeratorDenominator(maxDoseQuantity, ratio) "maxDose";
    } "maxDose";
  };
  // Lien CarePlan.
  sa ->  carePlan.supportingInfo = create('Reference') as supportRef,  supportRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %medicationRequest.id) "supportingInfo";
}

// DEMANDE D’EXAMEN OU DE SUIVI -> ServiceRequest
group PSPlanServiceRequestEntry(source obs, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // ServiceRequest.
  obs ->  bundle.entry as serviceRequestEntry,  serviceRequestEntry.resource = create('ServiceRequest') as serviceRequest,  serviceRequest.id = uuid(),  serviceRequestEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %serviceRequest.id) then PSPlanServiceRequest(obs, serviceRequest, carePlan, compSection, patient) "serviceRequest";
}

group PSPlanServiceRequest(source obs, target serviceRequest : ServiceRequest, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut.
  obs -> serviceRequest.status = 'active' "statusDefault";
  obs.statusCode as statusCode then {
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> serviceRequest.status = 'active' "active";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> serviceRequest.status = 'completed' "completed";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> serviceRequest.status = 'revoked' "aborted";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> serviceRequest.status = 'revoked' "cancelled";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> serviceRequest.status = 'on-hold' "suspended";
  } "status";
  // Intention.
  obs -> serviceRequest.intent = 'plan' "intentDefault";
  obs.moodCode as moodCode then {
    moodCode where moodCode = 'INT' -> serviceRequest.intent = 'plan' "intent";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'GOL' -> serviceRequest.intent = 'plan' "goal";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'PRP' -> serviceRequest.intent = 'proposal' "proposal";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'RQO' -> serviceRequest.intent = 'order' "order";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'ARQ' -> serviceRequest.intent = 'order' "appointmentRequest";
  } "intent";
  // Identifiant.
  obs.id as id -> serviceRequest.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Patient.
  obs ->  serviceRequest.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Code.
  obs.code as code -> serviceRequest.code = create('CodeableConcept') as codeableConcept then CDCodeableConcept(code, codeableConcept);
  // Note.
  obs.text as text then PSPlanTextToNote(text, serviceRequest);
  // Commentaire.
  obs.entryRelationship as er then PSPlanCommentToNote(er, serviceRequest) "comment";
  // Période.
  obs.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> serviceRequest.occurrence = create('dateTime') as occurrenceDateTime then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, occurrenceDateTime) "dateTime";
    effectiveTime.low as low -> serviceRequest.occurrence = create('Period') as period then {
      low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    } "period";
  } "occurrence";
  // Détail.
  obs.value as value -> serviceRequest.orderDetail = create('CodeableConcept') as orderDetail then CDCodeableConcept(value, orderDetail) "orderDetail";
  // Site.
  obs.targetSiteCode as targetSiteCode -> serviceRequest.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as bodySite then CDCodeableConcept(targetSiteCode, bodySite) "bodySite";
  // Lien CarePlan.
  obs ->  carePlan.supportingInfo = create('Reference') as supportRef,  supportRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %serviceRequest.id) "supportingInfo";
}

// ACTE PRÉVU -> Procedure
group PSPlanProcedureEntry(source proc, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Procedure.
  proc ->  bundle.entry as procedureEntry,  procedureEntry.resource = create('Procedure') as fhirProcedure,  fhirProcedure.id = uuid(),  procedureEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id) then PSPlanProcedure(proc, fhirProcedure, carePlan, compSection, patient) "procedure";
}

group PSPlanProcedure(source proc, target fhirProcedure : Procedure, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut.
  proc -> fhirProcedure.status = 'preparation' "statusDefault";
  proc.statusCode as statusCode then {
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'preparation' "active";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'completed' "completed";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'stopped' "aborted";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'stopped' "cancelled";
    statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> fhirProcedure.status = 'on-hold' "suspended";
  } "status";
  // Identifiant.
  proc.id as id -> fhirProcedure.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Patient.
  proc ->  fhirProcedure.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Code.
  proc.code as code -> fhirProcedure.code = create('CodeableConcept') as procedureCode then CDCodeableConcept(code, procedureCode);
  // Note.
  proc.text as text then PSPlanTextToNote(text, fhirProcedure);
  // Commentaire.
  proc.entryRelationship as er then PSPlanCommentToNote(er, fhirProcedure) "comment";
  // Date.
  proc.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> fhirProcedure.performed = create('dateTime') as performedDateTime then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, performedDateTime) "dateTime";
    effectiveTime.low as low -> fhirProcedure.performed = create('Period') as period then {
      low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    } "period";
  } "performed";
  // Site cible.
  proc.targetSiteCode as targetSiteCode -> fhirProcedure.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as bodySite then CDCodeableConcept(targetSiteCode, bodySite) "targetSite";
  // Voie d’abord.
  proc.approachSiteCode as approachSiteCode -> fhirProcedure.bodySite = create('CodeableConcept') as bodySite then CDCodeableConcept(approachSiteCode, bodySite) "approachSite";
  // Lien CarePlan.
  proc ->  carePlan.supportingInfo = create('Reference') as supportRef,  supportRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %fhirProcedure.id) "supportingInfo";
}

// RENCONTRE PRÉVUE -> Encounter
group PSPlanEncounterEntry(source enc, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Encounter.
  enc ->  bundle.entry as encounterEntry,  encounterEntry.resource = create('Encounter') as plannedEncounter,  plannedEncounter.id = uuid(),  encounterEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %plannedEncounter.id) then PSPlanEncounter(enc, plannedEncounter, carePlan, compSection, bundle, patient) "encounter";
}

group PSPlanEncounter(source enc, target plannedEncounter : Encounter, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Statut.
  enc -> plannedEncounter.status = 'planned' "statusDefault";
  enc.moodCode as moodCode then {
    moodCode where moodCode = 'ARQ' -> plannedEncounter.status = 'planned' "plannedARQ";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'INT' -> plannedEncounter.status = 'planned' "plannedINT";
    moodCode where moodCode = 'EVN' -> plannedEncounter.status = 'finished' "finished";
  } "status";
  // Identifiant.
  enc.id as id -> plannedEncounter.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Patient.
  enc ->  plannedEncounter.subject = create('Reference') as subjectRef,  subjectRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "subject";
  // Classe.
  enc.code as code -> plannedEncounter.class = create('Coding') as classCoding then CDCoding(code, classCoding) "class";
  // Type.
  enc.code as code -> plannedEncounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as encounterType then CDCodeableConcept(code, encounterType) "type";
  // Période.
  enc.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> plannedEncounter.period = create('Period') as period then {
      effectiveTime -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, start) "start";
    };
    effectiveTime.low as low -> plannedEncounter.period = create('Period') as period then {
      low -> period.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "start";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> period.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "end";
    } "interval";
  } "period";
  // Professionnel.
  enc.performer as performer then PSPlanEncounterPerformer(performer, plannedEncounter, bundle);
  // Lieu.
  enc.participant as participant then PSPlanEncounterLocation(participant, plannedEncounter, bundle) "location";
  // Lien CarePlan.
  enc ->  carePlan.encounter = create('Reference') as encounterRef,  encounterRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %plannedEncounter.id) "carePlanEncounter";
}

group PSPlanEncounterPerformer(source performer, target plannedEncounter : Encounter, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // Practitioner.
  performer.assignedEntity as assignedEntity ->  bundle.entry as practitionerEntry,  practitionerEntry.resource = create('Practitioner') as practitioner,  practitioner.id = uuid(),  practitionerEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) then {
    assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitioner(assignedEntity, practitioner) "practitionerBase";
    assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitioner(assignedEntity, practitioner) "practitionerFR";
    // PractitionerRole.
    assignedEntity.representedOrganization as representedOrganization ->  bundle.entry as organizationEntry,  organizationEntry.resource = create('Organization') as organization,  organization.id = uuid(),  organizationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %organization.id),  bundle.entry as roleEntry,  roleEntry.resource = create('PractitionerRole') as practitionerRole,  practitionerRole.id = uuid(),  roleEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) then {
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationBase";
      representedOrganization then MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization(representedOrganization, organization) "organizationFR";
      assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole(assignedEntity, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleBase";
      assignedEntity then MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole(assignedEntity, practitionerRole, practitioner, organization) "roleFR";
      // Participant avec rôle.
      assignedEntity -> plannedEncounter.participant as participant then {
        assignedEntity ->  participant.individual = create('Reference') as individualRef,  individualRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitionerRole.id) "roleRef";
      } "participantRole";
    } "withOrganization";
    // Participant sans organisation.
    assignedEntity where assignedEntity.representedOrganization.empty() -> plannedEncounter.participant as participant then {
      assignedEntity ->  participant.individual = create('Reference') as individualRef,  individualRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %practitioner.id) "practitionerRef";
    } "participantPractitioner";
  } "performer";
}

group PSPlanEncounterLocation(source participant, target plannedEncounter : Encounter, target bundle : Bundle) {
  // Location.
  participant.participantRole as participantRole where participant.typeCode = 'LOC' ->  bundle.entry as locationEntry,  locationEntry.resource = create('Location') as location,  location.id = uuid(),  locationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %location.id) then {
    // Identifiant.
    participantRole.id as id -> location.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
    // Type.
    participantRole.code as code -> location.type = create('CodeableConcept') as locationType then CDCodeableConcept(code, locationType) "type";
    // Adresse.
    participantRole.addr as addr -> location.address = create('Address') as address then ADAddress(addr, address) "address";
    // Télécom.
    participantRole.telecom as telecom -> location.telecom = create('ContactPoint') as contactPoint then TELContactPoint(telecom, contactPoint);
    // Nom.
    participantRole.playingEntity as playingEntity then {
      playingEntity.name as name -> location.name = (name.xmlText);
    };
    // Lien Encounter.
    participantRole -> plannedEncounter.location as encounterLocation then {
      participantRole ->  encounterLocation.location = create('Reference') as locationRef,  locationRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %location.id) "locationRef";
    } "encounterLocation";
  } "location";
}

// VACCIN RECOMMANDÉ -> ImmunizationRecommendation
group PSPlanImmunizationRecommendationEntry(source sa, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // ImmunizationRecommendation.
  sa ->  bundle.entry as recommendationEntry,  recommendationEntry.resource = create('ImmunizationRecommendation') as recommendation,  recommendation.id = uuid(),  recommendationEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %recommendation.id) then PSPlanImmunizationRecommendation(sa, recommendation, carePlan, compSection, patient) "recommendation";
}

group PSPlanImmunizationRecommendation(source sa, target recommendation : ImmunizationRecommendation, target carePlan : CarePlan, target compSection, target patient : Patient) {
  // Identifiant.
  sa.id as id -> recommendation.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
  // Patient.
  sa ->  recommendation.patient = create('Reference') as patientRef,  patientRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "patient";
  // Date.
  sa.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
    effectiveTime.value as value -> recommendation.date = create('dateTime') as recommendationDate then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, recommendationDate) "dateValue";
    effectiveTime.low as low where effectiveTime.value.empty() -> recommendation.date = create('dateTime') as recommendationDate then TSDateTime(low, recommendationDate) "dateLow";
    effectiveTime.high as high where effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty() -> recommendation.date = create('dateTime') as recommendationDate then TSDateTime(high, recommendationDate) "dateHigh";
    effectiveTime where effectiveTime.value.empty() and effectiveTime.low.empty() and effectiveTime.high.empty() -> recommendation.date = create('dateTime') as recommendationDate then {
      effectiveTime -> recommendationDate.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
        effectiveTime -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
        effectiveTime -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
      } "dataAbsentReason";
    } "datePresentWithoutValue";
  } "recommendationDate";
  // Date absente.
  sa where sa.effectiveTime.empty() -> recommendation.date = create('dateTime') as recommendationDate then {
    sa -> recommendationDate.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
      sa -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
      sa -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
    } "dataAbsentReason";
  } "recommendationDateAbsentReason";
  // Recommandation.
  sa -> recommendation.recommendation as rec then {
    // Statut prévisionnel.
    sa.statusCode as statusCode then {
      statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> rec.forecastStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as forecastStatus then {
        statusCode -> forecastStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
          statusCode -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-status' "system";
          statusCode -> coding.code = 'due' "code";
          statusCode -> coding.display = 'Due' "display";
        } "coding";
      } "active";
      statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> rec.forecastStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as forecastStatus then {
        statusCode -> forecastStatus.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
          statusCode -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-status' "system";
          statusCode -> coding.code = 'complete' "code";
          statusCode -> coding.display = 'Complete' "display";
        } "coding";
      } "completed";
      statusCode.code as code where (code != 'active') and (code != 'completed') -> rec.forecastStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as forecastStatus then PSPlanCodeableConceptAbsentReason(statusCode, forecastStatus) "unknown";
    } "forecastStatus";
    // Statut absent.
    sa where sa.statusCode.empty() -> rec.forecastStatus = create('CodeableConcept') as forecastStatus then PSPlanCodeableConceptAbsentReason(sa, forecastStatus) "forecastStatusAbsent";
    // Code vaccin.
    sa.code as code -> rec.vaccineCode = create('CodeableConcept') as vaccineActCode then CDCodeableConcept(code, vaccineActCode) "vaccineActCode";
    // Produit vaccinal.
    sa.consumable as consumable then {
      consumable.manufacturedProduct as manufacturedProduct then {
        manufacturedProduct.manufacturedMaterial as material then {
          material.code as code -> rec.vaccineCode = create('CodeableConcept') as vaccineCode then CDCodeableConcept(code, vaccineCode) "vaccineCode";
        } "material";
      };
    } "vaccineProduct";
    // Dates de recommandation.
    sa.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
      effectiveTime.value as value -> rec.dateCriterion as dateCriterion then {
        effectiveTime -> dateCriterion.code = create('CodeableConcept') as criterionCode then {
          effectiveTime -> criterionCode.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
            effectiveTime -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-date-criterion' "system";
            effectiveTime -> coding.code = 'due' "code";
            effectiveTime -> coding.display = 'Due Date' "display";
          } "coding";
        } "code";
        effectiveTime -> dateCriterion.value = create('dateTime') as dateValue then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, dateValue) "value";
      } "dateValue";
      effectiveTime.low as low -> rec.dateCriterion as dateCriterion then {
        low -> dateCriterion.code = create('CodeableConcept') as criterionCode then {
          low -> criterionCode.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
            low -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-date-criterion' "system";
            low -> coding.code = 'earliest' "code";
            low -> coding.display = 'Earliest Date' "display";
          } "coding";
        } "code";
        low -> dateCriterion.value = create('dateTime') as dateValue then TSDateTime(low, dateValue) "value";
      } "dateLow";
      effectiveTime.high as high -> rec.dateCriterion as dateCriterion then {
        high -> dateCriterion.code = create('CodeableConcept') as criterionCode then {
          high -> criterionCode.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
            high -> coding.system = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/immunization-recommendation-date-criterion' "system";
            high -> coding.code = 'latest' "code";
            high -> coding.display = 'Latest Date' "display";
          } "coding";
        } "code";
        high -> dateCriterion.value = create('dateTime') as dateValue then TSDateTime(high, dateValue) "value";
      } "dateHigh";
    } "dateCriterion";
    // Commentaire.
    sa.entryRelationship as er then PSPlanCommentToRecommendationDescription(er, rec) "comment";
  } "recommendation";
  // Lien CarePlan.
  sa ->  carePlan.supportingInfo = create('Reference') as supportRef,  supportRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %recommendation.id) "supportingInfo";
}

// TEXTES, COMMENTAIRES ET ABSENCE DE DONNÉES
group PSPlanTextToNote(source text, target tgt) {
  // Note par référence.
  text.reference as reference then {
    reference.value as value ->  tgt.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(value, 'string') "reference";
  };
  // Note texte.
  text.xmlText as xml where text.reference.empty() ->  tgt.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(xml, 'string');
}

group PSPlanCommentToNote(source er, target tgt) {
  // Commentaire.
  er.act as act where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
    act.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' then {
        act.text as text then PSPlanTextToNote(text, tgt) "note";
      } "comment";
    } "template";
  };
}

group PSPlanTextToRecommendationDescription(source text, target rec) {
  // Description par référence.
  text.reference as reference then {
    reference.value as value -> rec.description = cast(value, 'string') "reference";
  };
  // Description texte.
  text.xmlText as xml where text.reference.empty() -> rec.description = cast(xml, 'string');
}

group PSPlanCommentToRecommendationDescription(source er, target rec) {
  // Commentaire.
  er.act as act where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
    act.templateId as tid then {
      tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' then {
        act.text as text then PSPlanTextToRecommendationDescription(text, rec) "description";
      } "comment";
    } "template";
  };
}

group PSPlanCodeableConceptAbsentReason(source src, target cc : CodeableConcept) {
  // Data absent reason.
  src -> cc.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
    src -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
    src -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
  } "dataAbsentReason";
}

// 9. ANTÉCÉDENTS FAMILIAUX -> FamilyMemberHistory
group PatientSummaryFamilyHistorySection(source section, target compSection, target bundle : Bundle, target patient : Patient) {
  // Entrées.
  section.entry as entry then {
    entry.organizer as familyOrganizer ->  bundle.entry as familyEntry,  familyEntry.resource = create('FamilyMemberHistory') as familyHistory,  familyHistory.id = uuid(),  familyEntry.fullUrl = ('urn:uuid:' + %familyHistory.id) then {
      // Statut.
      familyOrganizer -> familyHistory.status = 'completed' "statusDefault";
      familyOrganizer.statusCode as statusCode then {
        statusCode.code as code where code = 'completed' -> familyHistory.status = 'completed' "statusCompleted";
        statusCode.code as code where code = 'active' -> familyHistory.status = 'partial' "statusActive";
        statusCode.code as code where code = 'aborted' -> familyHistory.status = 'entered-in-error' "statusAborted";
        statusCode.code as code where code = 'cancelled' -> familyHistory.status = 'entered-in-error' "statusCancelled";
        statusCode.code as code where code = 'suspended' -> familyHistory.status = 'partial' "statusSuspended";
      } "status";
      // Identifiant.
      familyOrganizer.id as id -> familyHistory.identifier = create('Identifier') as identifier then II(id, identifier) "identifier";
      // Patient.
      familyOrganizer ->  familyHistory.patient = create('Reference') as patientRef,  patientRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %patient.id) "patient";
      // Lien familial.
      familyOrganizer.subject as subject then {
        subject.relatedSubject as relatedSubject then {
          // Relation.
          relatedSubject.code as relationshipCode -> familyHistory.relationship = create('CodeableConcept') as relationship then CDCodeableConcept(relationshipCode, relationship) "relationshipCode";
          // Personne apparentée.
          relatedSubject.subject as relatedPerson then {
            // Sexe.
            relatedPerson.administrativeGenderCode as genderCode -> familyHistory.sex = create('CodeableConcept') as sex then {
              genderCode.code as v -> sex.coding = create('Coding') as coding then {
                v -> coding.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/administrative-gender' "sexSystem";
                v -> coding.code = translate(v, 'https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/ConceptMap/cm-v3-administrative-gender', 'code') "sexCode";
                v where v = 'F' -> coding.display = 'Female' "sexDisplayFemale";
                v where v = 'M' -> coding.display = 'Male' "sexDisplayMale";
                v where v = 'UN' -> coding.display = 'Unknown' "sexDisplayUnknown";
              } "sexCoding";
              genderCode.displayName as display -> sex.text = cast(display, 'string') "sexText";
            } "sex";
            // Nom.
            relatedPerson.name as name then {
              name.xmlText as nameText -> familyHistory.name = cast(nameText, 'string') "nameText";
            };
            // Naissance.
            relatedPerson.birthTime as birthTime -> familyHistory.born = create('date') as bornDate then TSDate(birthTime, bornDate) "bornDate";
            // Décès.
            relatedPerson.deceasedTime as deceasedTime -> familyHistory.deceased = create('date') as deceasedDate then TSDate(deceasedTime, deceasedDate) "deceasedDate";
            relatedPerson.deceasedInd as deceasedInd where relatedPerson.deceasedTime.empty() -> familyHistory.deceased = create('boolean') as deceasedBoolean then {
              deceasedInd.value as value -> deceasedBoolean.value = value "deceasedBooleanValue";
            } "deceasedBoolean";
          } "relatedPerson";
        };
      };
      // Relation depuis participant si subject absent.
      familyOrganizer where familyOrganizer.subject.empty() then {
        familyOrganizer.participant as participant then {
          participant.participantRole as participantRole then {
            participantRole.code as relationshipCode -> familyHistory.relationship = create('CodeableConcept') as relationship then CDCodeableConcept(relationshipCode, relationship) "relationshipFromParticipant";
          };
        };
      } "participantFallbackNoSubject";
      // Relation depuis participant si code absent.
      familyOrganizer.subject as subject then {
        subject.relatedSubject as relatedSubject where relatedSubject.code.empty() then {
          familyOrganizer.participant as participant then {
            participant.participantRole as participantRole then {
              participantRole.code as relationshipCode -> familyHistory.relationship = create('CodeableConcept') as relationship then CDCodeableConcept(relationshipCode, relationship) "relationshipFromParticipant";
            };
          };
        } "noRelationshipCode";
      } "participantFallbackNoRelationship";
      // Relation inconnue.
      familyOrganizer where familyOrganizer.subject.empty() and familyOrganizer.participant.empty() -> familyHistory.relationship = create('CodeableConcept') as relationship then {
        familyOrganizer -> relationship.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
          familyOrganizer -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
          familyOrganizer -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
        } "dataAbsentReason";
      } "relationshipAbsent";
      // Conditions familiales.
      familyOrganizer.component as component then {
        component.observation as familyObservation -> familyHistory.condition as condition then {
          // Code de la condition.
          familyObservation.value as value -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as conditionCode then CDCodeableConcept(value, conditionCode) "conditionCode";
          // Type d’observation.
          familyObservation.code as observationType then {
            observationType.displayName as display ->  condition.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(display, 'string') "observationTypeDisplay";
          } "observationType";
          // Condition inconnue.
          familyObservation where familyObservation.value.empty() -> condition.code = create('CodeableConcept') as conditionCode then {
            familyObservation -> conditionCode.extension = create('Extension') as absentReason then {
              familyObservation -> absentReason.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason' "url";
              familyObservation -> absentReason.value = cast('unknown', 'code') "valueCode";
            } "dataAbsentReason";
          } "conditionCodeAbsent";
          // Période d’apparition.
          familyObservation.effectiveTime as effectiveTime then {
            effectiveTime.value as value -> condition.onset = create('Period') as onsetPeriod then {
              effectiveTime -> onsetPeriod.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(effectiveTime, start) "onsetStart";
            } "onsetValue";
            effectiveTime.low as low -> condition.onset = create('Period') as onsetPeriod then {
              low -> onsetPeriod.start = create('dateTime') as start then TSDateTime(low, start) "onsetLow";
              effectiveTime.high as high -> onsetPeriod.end = create('dateTime') as end then TSDateTime(high, end) "onsetHigh";
            } "onsetPeriod";
          };
          // Commentaire.
          familyObservation.entryRelationship as er then {
            er.act as commentAct where er.typeCode = 'SUBJ' then {
              commentAct.templateId as tid then {
                tid.root as root where root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.1.3.32' then {
                  commentAct.text as text then {
                    text.reference as reference then {
                      reference.value as value ->  condition.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(value, 'string') "commentReference";
                    } "commentTextReference";
                    text.xmlText as xml where text.reference.empty() ->  condition.note = create('Annotation') as note,  note.text = cast(xml, 'string') "commentText";
                  } "commentText";
                } "comment";
              } "commentTemplate";
            } "commentAct";
          };
        } "condition";
      } "components";
      // Référence section.
      familyOrganizer ->  compSection.entry = create('Reference') as sectionRef,  sectionRef.reference = ('urn:uuid:' + %familyHistory.id) "sectionEntry";
    } "familyHistory";
  } "sectionEntry";
}
